basis: Only feature group improving both TRAIN nested-OOF measures in all three folds.
architecture: Same five fixed seeds and 128/64 network; same300/45 checkpoint protocol.
candidates: Two pools and convex blends with the unchanged forest or current selected ensemble.
eligibility: Strict lower validation KZT MAE and higher within20 than current Robust ensemble; rank equal normalized MAE and miss fraction.
test: No test predictions or model promotion in this script. No further feature groups tried on validation.
